message.content:
On guidance management now expects fourth fiscal quarter 2026 revenue to be in the range of $1.930 billion to $1.950 billion with a mid-point representing year-over-year growth of approximately 37% [D1], which represents an improvement from the previous release that expected third fiscal quarter 2026 revenue in the range of $1.730 billion to $1.750 billion with a mid-point representing year-over-year growth of approximately 29% [D2].

What is working includes record Q3 results and outlook reflecting the growing relevance of strategy and portfolio enabling customers to solve complex engineering challenges across end markets [D1], strong momentum in commercial communications showing 56 percent growth [D1], solid performance in aerospace defense and government with 14 percent growth [D1], and double-digit growth across all end markets for the electronic industrial solutions group including automotive energy general electronics and semiconductor [D2].

What is not working includes certain items impacting the GAAP tax rate pertaining to future events that are not currently estimable with a reasonable degree of accuracy [D1] and risks such as impacts of global economic conditions including inflation or recession slowing demand for products or services volatility in financial markets reduced access to credit increased interest rates impacts of geopolitical tension and conflict outside of the U.S. export control regulations and compliance net zero emissions commitments customer purchasing decisions and timing tariff and trade policy impacts and order cancellations [D1].
